import json,sys
d=Path(sys.argv[1]); p=d/'extraction.md'
lines=['## Executed probe checks']

 lines.append(f'- {k} — {c["statement"]} {c["source"]}:{c["line"]} ("{c["fragment"]}"). Jev {c["choice"]}. '+reasons.get(k,'The assertion and its scheduling setup were reviewed against the executed result.'))
with p.open('a') as f:f.write('\n'+'\n\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
